kentuckyDorGeoSyncDocument.title: GeoSync 3.2.56 Map Annotation and Printing Instructions
observedDefinitions: MUID is described as MapSync Unique IDentifying number and should be in all editable layers.
Parcel_ID should contain the entire parcel number (example 001-20-03-004.00).
Map# contains map number and block, Block stores the block, and Parcel stores the parcel component; parcel suffixes such as 4.05 are explicitly used for a split.
kentuckyDorGeoSyncDocument.limitation: This is an official statewide workflow document, not a Franklin County schema statement. The public Franklin layer has no MUID field.

observedDefinitions: PIN is glossed as Property Identification Number (Map number).
Block and Lot are described as frequent components of a geographically organized PIN; block refers to an individual map and lot to an individual parcel on the map.
franklinPvaTaxLingo.limitation: This vocabulary does not explain duplicate component rows or define MAPNUM, PARCEL_ID, MAP, BLOCK, PARCEL, SOURCE_TYP, or v_SY in the live service.

fieldsObserved.SOURCE_TYP: string; coded values DEED, PLAT, PVA MAP, SURVEY

metadataLimitations: No layer description or copyright text

countywideComponentComparison.summary: MAP/BLOCK/PARCEL are not a complete one-row-per-cadastral-record reference in this service. A grouped aggregate returned repeated triples (top group count 7); MAP/BLOCK/PARCEL omit the split suffix in many rows. In an inspected triple, MAP=074-12, BLOCK=13, PARCEL=6 included distinct full PARCEL_ID/MAPNUM suffixes .05, .06 and .08. MAPNUM and PARCEL_ID agree in the inspected 103 rows, but do not always agree with the exposed PARCEL component.
countywideComponentComparison.aggregateMethod: ArcGIS count-only predicates and groupByFieldsForStatistics with identifiers and count only; no geometry or owner fields.
countywideComponentComparison.caveat: The unfiltered grouped aggregate returned 2,000 rows and exceededTransferLimit=true. These are lower-bound duplicate observations, not a full inventory of repeated groups.

boundedExamples.evidence: For PARCEL_ID 061-00-00-103.00, a 3-record exact-key query returned 2 polygons: MAPNUM/PARCEL_ID 103.00, MAP 061, blank BLOCK, PARCEL 103, SOURCE_TYP PVA MAP, v_SY 2017; and the same MAPNUM/PARCEL_ID, MAP 061, null BLOCK, PARCEL 103.18, SOURCE_TYP DEED, v_SY 2017. For PARCEL_ID 103.18, the exact-key query returned 2 different polygons: PVA MAP with PARCEL 103.00 and v_SY null; DEED with PARCEL 103.18 and v_SY null. Grouped counts for each PARCEL_ID+PARCEL pair were 1 in these four rows.
boundedExamples.geometryComparison: GEOS comparison of the four returned EPSG:4326 polygons found zero positive-area intersection across every pair. The two rows sharing key 103.00 share a boundary only. No union or source-type/v_SY filter was applied.

officialMapNumberCorroboration.observation: A 2022 City of Frankfort ordinance identifies 061-00-00-103.18 as a PVA Map Number, corroborating that suffix as an assessor-recognized map number; it does not explain the 2017 duplicate component rows or establish current geometry.

boundedExamples.sampleGeometry: The first 3 of 17 rows were inspected. Two are disjoint; one pair touches only at a boundary; no positive-area overlap was found among the three. The remaining 14 geometries were not examined. This is evidence for a multipart possibility, not proof of complete group disjointness or publisher-defined multipart semantics.

PARCEL_ID_plus_PARCEL.assessment: Repeated composite groups exist. The top nonblank group observed has 17 rows; blank PARCEL_ID groups were also present (one observed count 38). Full countywide group inventory and geometry overlap checks were not performed.

MAP_BLOCK_PARCEL.assessment: The component triple repeats, and PARCEL can omit the split suffix. It cannot replace the full parcel identifier in this layer.

countyAggregateIdentityAudit.countDistinctAttempt: ArcGIS countdistinct statistics returned HTTP 200 with an ArcGIS 400 error; no count-distinct conclusion was derived.

currencyAndCurrentGround.assessment: Not established. The live service has SOURCE_TYP categories and v_SY values spanning 1900 through 2026, null values, and a small anomalous 5202 value. The field v_SY is undocumented in the service. A current service response and 2026-valued rows do not prove that every geometry is the current cadastral boundary. No version or SOURCE_TYP filter was applied.

additionalEvidence.observation: The PVA describes annual assessment of taxable real property and examination at least once every four years; that is assessment administration, not a map-geometry refresh guarantee.

countyLinkedViewer.assessment: Official county page links this ArcGIS app and describes it as including zoning. The public web-map configuration contains no cadastral parcel layer; it is not an alternative parcel source.

PvaPropertySearch.observation: The PVA advertises a free basic property search and a subscription service for additional records. Search results and official PVA-linked 2023 report PDFs identify qPublic/Schneider as the interface.
PvaPropertySearch.viewerRequestResult: Direct browser-header GET returned HTTP 403 challenge HTML titled 'Just a moment...'. No challenge was bypassed. The layer service remained directly queryable. The challenge is a viewer-access observation, not a claim that the underlying service is blocked.

otherOfficialPaths.observation: eCCLIX is an indexed deed/land-record search with subscription/commercial and limited resident access; it is not a parcel-polygon download.

Kentucky describes its public ArcGIS server as statewide mapping services; catalog search found a PVA parcel service for Webster County, not a verified Franklin County statewide feed. Kentucky’s mapping program documents county-specific PVA data products and a request route through the local PVA.

remainingUncertainty: The county layer exposes no published MUID and no definition for v_SY or per-row lifecycle. Statewide guidance supports the meaning of full Parcel_ID plus map/block/parcel components, but the live Franklin County feed violates one-row-per-PARCEL_ID conventions and repeated PARCEL_ID+PARCEL pairs occur countywide. The coordinator verified complete disjoint compound groups within the configured Frankfort gate; untested groups and their version/current-boundary semantics remain unresolved. No alternate open Franklin County or City of Frankfort cadastral feed was verified. The official DOR digital data request path and official PVA/qPublic search remain leads, not public parcel-polygon download endpoints.
